meta.description: ICHU by SmartFarm: livestock monitoring with smart collars, herd records, and veterinary history.

terms.authentication: Sign-in is handled by Firebase Authentication. The ICHU API checks your account and ranch permissions before showing ranch data. Passwords are sent only to Firebase Authentication and are never stored by the application.
terms.records: ICHU stores collar telemetry and ranch records for each ranch, and shows them only to accounts with access to that ranch.
terms.preferences: Your selected language and ranch are stored in this browser.
terms.payments: Payments are processed by Stripe. ICHU never stores card data.
terms.contact: Contact SmartFarm about these terms or your data.

notFound.body: Check the address or return to your ICHU account.

login.title: Welcome back
login.note: Sign-in is checked by the ICHU account service.
login.navigationFailed: Your workspace could not open. Try again.

register.title: Create an account
register.name: Full name
register.ranchDetailsNote: These details create your initial ranch account.
register.ranchDetailsRequired: Complete all ranch details and enter a positive whole number for herd size.
register.terms: I agree to the ICHU Terms of Use.
register.termsRequired: Confirm that you agree before continuing.
register.passwordNote: Your password is sent to Firebase Authentication and is never included in this review.
register.retryNotice: Account setup is not complete. Retry with the same email and password to finish it.
register.verifyNotice: Your account was created. Check your inbox for a Firebase verification email before signing in.

recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.lead: Enter the email address for your ICHU account.
recovery.note: If an account exists for this address, Firebase will send a password-reset email.
recovery.resultBody: If the address belongs to an account, a password-reset link is on its way.
